from ledgerly.reporting import day_bounds

    assert list_price("team") == 49.0
    assert apply_coupon(49.0, "WELCOME10") == 44.1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_coupon(49.0, "NOPE")

    assert campaign_percent("black-friday", now=datetime(2025, 11, 28)) == 30

def test_reporting_and_renewals():

    assert (end - start).days == 1
    assert reminder_due(datetime(2026, 1, 10), now=datetime(2026, 1, 8))

a = Payment("a","inv",Decimal("1"),created_at=datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC))
b = Payment("b","inv",Decimal("1"),created_at=datetime(2026,1,3,tzinfo=UTC))
# half-open: end excluded
print(payments_between([b,a], datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,3,tzinfo=UTC)) == [a])
# offset normalization: 2026-01-02 01:00+02:00 == 2026-01-01 23:00 UTC
c = Payment("c","inv",Decimal("1"),created_at=datetime(2026,1,2,1,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=2))))
print(payments_between([c], datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC)) == [c])
# naive start rejected
try:
    payments_between([a], datetime(2026,1,1), datetime(2026,1,3,tzinfo=UTC))
except BillingError as e:
    print("naive start:", e.code)
# naive end rejected
try:
    payments_between([a], datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,3))
except BillingError as e:
    print("naive end:", e.code)
